test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1) 'NT – QL':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d2687e8cf21bd45983600dceb61d82dd61481c95d8e2bcf7dd032c921f81049.png] 

**Option (2) 'GM – JE':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d533ea4f44cad34d18f3e75a72831d67ac15acf11d7c7c94073ae943246ea84.png] 

**Option (3) 'RX – VP':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67217063abb8d95525b216cfd031fd5de5b2006007124f1273bfe0d399070094.png] 

Here, it does not follow.

**Option (4) 'AG – DY':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d2d545dfa1b451b1cc202b98d8ffed51099a8041bd8a6536341e88ccb1f6b19.png]
